---
title: "External debt book"
guide-section: "Debt modules"
---

Excel analogue: **`Ext_Debt_Data`** — existing PPG external MLT, new portfolio
MLT, ST / locally issued / SDR pieces, creditor groups, grant element, and
PPG PV headlines (e.g. Ext R391).

**Edit Ext / Input 4–5 in Excel**, save, then `load_core`.

## What you get

| Piece | Role |
|-------|------|
| `ExternalDebtBook` | Sheet engine: `portfolio` + Ext inputs |
| `load_core` (`lic_dsf.load`) | Wires portfolio + Ext + Macro + baselines |
| `PVPortfolio` | New MLT schedules ([pv-instruments.qmd](pv-instruments.qmd)) |
| `load_stress` (`lic_dsf.load`) | Includes Input 7 residual-financing terms used in stress |

Creditor grouping, grant element, debt evolution, and memorandum panels are
methods / helpers on or under this book — not on `PVPortfolio`.

## Load and compute

```python
from pathlib import Path

from lic_dsf.load import load_core

workbook = Path("data/lic-dsf-template-2025-08-12.xlsx")
macro, external, ext_base, pub_base = load_core(workbook)

external.total_pv_of_debt()  # Ext R391-style PPG PV
external.new_mlt_pv()  # new portfolio only
external.existing_mlt_pv()  # existing by creditor + Total
external.new_disbursements_by_creditor()
external.debt_evolution()
external.summary()  # compact headline table when available
```

## Excel cues

| Concept | Typical Ext cue |
|---------|-----------------|
| Total PPG external PV | R391 |
| New MLT PV / stock | R279 / R329 |
| Existing MLT PV | R242 block |
| Debt service aggregates | R394–396 |
| Residual financing terms | Input 7 (via `load_stress`) |

## Architecture (brief)

```text
load_core
   → ExternalDebtBook (portfolio + Ext inputs)
   → MacroDebtBook / Baseline DSA
```
